d:
Bihar men mausam ka mijaj dhire-dhire badal raha hai. subah aur rat ke samay thand ka ehsas barhne laga hai, jabki din men dhup nikalne se logon ko abhi bhi garmi se puri tarah rahat nahin mili hai. is bich bangal ki khari men ganbhir chakravati tuphan 'akvan' sakriy hai. mausam vibhag ne aane vale dinon ke lie purvanuman jari kiya hai. janie mausam ka hal
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
